<thought>We need a retrosynthetic route for the sulfonamide product. The precursors are phenylsulfonyl chloride and the amine (second SMILES). We must find a template that forms the N‑S bond and breaks the S‑Cl bond. We'll search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks a halide (Cl) and forms a sulfonamide. Then we will construct the JSON route with the product molecule, a reaction node containing the found template_id, and the two precursor molecules as children.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(=O)(Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(CCC3(CCC3)O3)=C(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C2=CC=CC=C2)C1=CC(F)=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
